{{Top|leg}}
An '''energy cartridge''' was a component of a [[tight-beam emitter]]. If it was replaced with the [[pivar spinner]] from a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], the emitter could be used to disrupt [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolts]].
